in_sanskrit.name: सत्यजित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Satyajit is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Satya' meaning truth, reality, and 'Jit' meaning victory, triumph. It is a name that embodies the qualities of truthfulness, sincerity, and victory.

in_marathi.name: Satyajit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satyajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Satyajit is a combination of two Sanskrit words: ‘Satyam’ meaning truth and ‘Jit’ meaning victory. This name is associated with the god Rama, who is known for his truthfulness and strength.
